about_short_description.short_description: Credgenics is a tech-enabled platform that specializes in debt recovery and legal automation.

product.name: Credgenics Full-Stack Debt Collections Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages loan collections and debt resolution across digital, calling, field, payment, and legal workflows.

product.name: Digital Debt Collections
product.description: A digital-first collections solution for automating borrower outreach, repayment requests, workflows, and recovery strategies across the loan lifecycle.

product.name: Collections Analytics
product.description: An analytics solution that uses machine learning to segment borrowers, predict payment behavior, optimize outreach, and monitor collections performance.

product.name: Digital Communications
product.description: A multichannel borrower communication service supporting personalized outreach through SMS, WhatsApp, email, IVR, voicebots, and chatbots.

product.name: Swara NextGen AI Assistant
product.description: A generative AI voicebot for borrower conversations, intent and sentiment identification, payment-link sharing, and collections follow-ups.

product.name: CG Collect Field App
product.description: A mobile application for digitizing field collections through case allocation, visit scheduling, location tracking, payment recording, and receipt generation.
